name: roll-call
description: The roll-call development process for Claude Code, instructions-only edition.

plugins.name: roll-call
plugins.description: A development process for Claude Code, as instructions only: sets up a replaceable nine-seat review roster and a table routing each change to the reviewer that owns it, checks that setup for guards that are asleep, and carries a written specification for building the enforcement hooks inside your own repository. Ships no hooks and no scripts.
